title: Rekindle works on LIVING heroes: free hero duplication / level skipping
steps: Press Rekindle on the healthy hero
Seed or reach level 20 and press Rekindle 4 times
expected: Rekindle is described as the post-Fall option; a live hero should not be clonable
actual: RETEST: Fresh classic hero card shows only Selected / Abilities / Retire / Test a Fall (0 living Rekindle buttons). After a Fall a Keepsake row appears: "Rekindle Alder (Lv 1)"; it rekindles once ("Alder is rekindled at level 1. The Keepsake stays in the stash"), then reads "Rekindled", disabled, title "This Keepsake already rekindled a hero". API: rekindle(living id) -> not-fallen; second use -> used; level-20 classic Keepsake -> one L10 hero; hardcore Fall -> no Keepsake; hardcore Keepsake -> hardcore-no-rekindle.
suspect: game/shared/mm-profile.js:180 rekindle() looks in living p.heroes and never removes the source; game/games/mad-maze/lantern.js:526 renders the button for every hero

actual: RETEST: 100 place/mine cycles of coal at an air cell on the surface: placed 100, mined 100, run state unchanged (blocks 0, ores 0, combo 0, bestCombo 0). Not re-checked as a real-time touch loop; genuine ore credit not re-verified.
suspect: game/games/deepdelve/deepdelve.js:91 PLACEABLE includes ore blocks; :459 mineBlock -> onMined; dd-run.js mined()

title: Device clock moved back inside the same week reopens Sunday buying and reveals future prices (unbounded bells)

Move clock to Sat PM same week, Sell all
Move clock back to Sunday same week
expected: Once the week has progressed, Sunday buying should not reopen
actual: RETEST: Fake clock Sun 22 Nov 10:00, buy 10, Sat PM sell all (+580), clock back to Sunday same week and reload: bells kept 1,680, still Sat PM, message "Your device clock moved back. The market keeps the latest time you saw, so trading is paused", Buy 10 did nothing.
